logic_errors.summary: text=True does not preserve exact native stdout/stderr, and undecodable output can prevent any diagnostic report being written.
logic_errors.evidence: Local subprocess reproduction on this host: raw stdout 410d0a / stderr 420d0a become A\n / B\n in text mode; a stdout byte ff raises UnicodeDecodeError. The helper writes its report only after this decoding succeeds for every row.
logic_errors.fix: Capture both streams as bytes. Store lossless base64 or hex, byte counts and SHA-256; optionally add a separately labelled decoded display field. Keep actual subprocess returncodes and do not change the SDK arguments or original gate.

logic_errors.summary: An uncaught TimeoutExpired or launch error discards previously accumulated rows and produces no failure JSON.
logic_errors.evidence: Static control flow: subprocess.run(timeout=30) is not protected; output.write_text is reached only after the whole loop. If a later JS parse times out, prior completed rows and available partial timeout streams are never persisted.
logic_errors.fix: Record timeout/launch-error status explicitly and preserve available binary streams plus prior rows; use null returncode when no native exit was observed. Persist the failure report without claiming all_parsed or gate success. Do not loosen timeout or original acceptance conditions.
